## Goal
Many people-search pages show "Age 45-49" or "In their 40s". `parse_age` (`src/freemyid/engine/matcher.py:104-112`) keeps only the first number, so a 48-year-old shown as "45-49" gets no age signal (`score` 222-224, within 2 years) and an "In their 70s" listing reads as age 70.

## Order
Start only after WO-242 (also edits `exposure.py`) and WO-233 (matcher tests) are merged.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. A new `parse_age_span(text) -> tuple[int, int] | None` in `matcher.py` reads a single age (lo == hi), a range (`45-49`, `45 to 49`) and a decade (`40s`, `in their 40s` -> 40-49); `parse_age` keeps its signature and current results for single ages.
2. `Candidate` (69-80) gains an optional `age_max: int | None = None` (dataclass field with a default, so every existing caller, including Grok's `submitters/web_form.py`, keeps working). `exposure.parse_candidates` (`src/freemyid/engine/exposure.py:332-366`) fills it from the span.
3. `score`: a span counts as the `age` signal only when the person's estimated age is inside it and the span is at most 10 years wide; the SEC-99 age-conflict cap (`AGE_CONFLICT_YEARS`, 37; 245-252) applies only when the age is more than 5 years outside the span. A plain single age behaves exactly as before.
4. `Listing` (in-house model) is not changed; `rescore` (260-) keeps working from stored fields.
5. Matcher tests (`tests/test_matcher*.py`, `tests/codex/test_cx_name_variants.py`, WO-233's file) and exposure tests still pass.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing; re-check them.
